# Agentic Intelligence System — Public Discovery

AIS exposes provider-agnostic capabilities for discovery. Local workstation, routing, model, cost, and repository-policy data remain private to the runtime.

## Capability Registry

### Multi-file engineering
- Capability: Plan, implement, and verify bounded changes across a codebase.
- Runtime: Provider-agnostic; selected privately for each task.

### Long-horizon orchestration
- Capability: Coordinate evidence-backed work across multiple dependent steps.
- Runtime: Provider-agnostic; selected privately for each task.

### Interactive product design
- Capability: Refine interfaces, layouts, and interaction details with visual feedback.
- Runtime: Provider-agnostic; selected privately for each task.

### Security and quality review
- Capability: Audit implementation risks and verify release gates.
- Runtime: Provider-agnostic; selected privately for each task.

### Fast configuration repair
- Capability: Apply and validate small, well-scoped configuration changes.
- Runtime: Provider-agnostic; selected privately for each task.

### Cross-repository operations
- Capability: Coordinate governed changes across related repositories.
- Runtime: Provider-agnostic; selected privately for each task.

## Public Skills

### Agent orchestration (v1.0.0)
- Description: Route, monitor, and hand off work between specialized agents.

### Capability routing (v1.0.0)
- Description: Match work to an appropriate capability based on complexity and risk.
